content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Aerospace components, valves, pumps and composite panels; no overlap with asphalt or aggregate plants."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Mainly farm machinery and precision agriculture; construction machines are a minor line, not asphalt or aggregate equipment."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Welding and cutting consumables and automation; different products and customers from road and aggregate equipment."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Municipal street sweepers, sirens and public safety systems; shares municipal customers but not plant or crushing equipment."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves and seals for process plants; no asphalt, aggregate or road-builder business."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Designs and builds asphalt plants and parts for road builders and asphalt producers, matching Astec's core business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, brake friction products and connectors; different products and customers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Papermaking and wood processing equipment for paper mills and sawmills; different process and customers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Switchgear and electrical distribution equipment for power customers; not road or aggregate machinery."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Industrial engines and generator sets sold to equipment makers; no plant or crushing equipment for road builders."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, lubricants and metalworking fluids; sells chemicals rather than manufactured machinery."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"HVAC, UV disinfection and detection instruments for buildings; different products and customers."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hinges and metal hardware for equipment makers; a component business with no overlap."}]}
